run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-16T18:35:50Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on otel-demo/frontend is caused by the frontend's calls to the Ad Service failing: the only ad pod (ad-554b849958-p226w) was stopped at 2026-11-16T18:34:48Z when Deployment ad was scaled 1->0 and immediately back to 1, and the ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 has since been unable to create a replacement because the namespace ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory is already exhausted (used memory=1901Mi vs hard 1503238553600m ~= 1.4GiB, while ad requests 225Mi). No ad pod exists, Service ad has no endpoints, and ad's span volume falls to 0. From 18:35:50Z the only new error spans in frontend are on the ad path (client span grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, server span GET /api/data, internal executing api route (pages) /api/data, plus tcp.connect), with frontend STATUS_CODE_ERROR rate rising from 0 to a peak of ~4.41 spans/s at 18:41:50Z; frontend-proxy error spans appear only on ingress and router frontend egress, consistent with proxying those failing frontend requests. All other 20 otel-demo pods are Running/Ready with 0 restarts, so the impact observed in this window is the ad-call path of frontend plus the frontend-proxy responses in front of it.

claims.text: frontend's STATUS_CODE_ERROR span rate was 0 through 18:34:50Z, first became nonzero at 18:35:50Z (0.5/s, matching the alert start), peaked at ~4.41/s at 18:41:50Z and was still ~1.18/s at the last sample 18:47:50Z.

Within frontend, errors appear only on span_name GET, GET /api/data, executing api route (pages) /api/data, grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds and tcp.connect; frontend error series for GET /api/cart, POST /api/cart, POST /api/checkout, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct-style cart/checkout paths stayed 0.

Baseline before the failure: at 18:34:06Z frontend's client span grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds returned rpc.grpc.status_code=0 and the ad span oteldemo.AdService/GetAds completed in 717us, and frontend GET /api/data returned http.status_code=200.

ad's own span rate (all statuses) fell from ~2.48/s at 18:35:00Z to 0 from 18:41:00Z onward, and ad's only STATUS_CODE_ERROR series in the window was 0.0037/s on flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream between 18:32:50Z and 18:36:50Z (no error spans on oteldemo.AdService/GetAds).

Deployment ad (otel-demo) has spec.replicas=1 but no status.readyReplicas, with conditions Available=False (MinimumReplicasUnavailable, lastTransitionTime 18:34:58Z) and ReplicaFailure=True carrying: pods "ad-554b849958-v9dqt" is forbidden: exceeded quota: otel-demo-memory, requested: memory=225Mi, used: memory=1901Mi, limited: memory=1503238553600m; its pod template revision is unchanged (deployment.kubernetes.io/revision=1) and the ad container requests 10m CPU / 225Mi memory (limit 450Mi).
ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 (owner Deployment ad) has spec.replicas=1, no readyReplicas, and its ReplicaFailure condition reports the same otel-demo-memory quota rejection for pod ad-554b849958-v9dqt.

Events in otel-demo show Deployment ad 'Scaled down replica set ad-554b849958 from 1 to 0' at 18:34:48Z with Killing 'Stopping container ad' on pod ad-554b849958-p226w and ReplicaSet SuccessfulDelete, then Deployment ad 'Scaled up replica set ad-554b849958 from 0 to 1' at 18:34:58Z followed by FailedCreate events (18:34:58Z-18:40:26Z) all reading 'exceeded quota: otel-demo-memory, requested: memory=225Mi, used: memory=1901Mi, limited: memory=1503238553600m'. No Evicted, OOMKilled or FailedScheduling events appear.

ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory in namespace otel-demo has status.hard memory=1503238553600m (~1.4GiB) and status.used memory=1901Mi, i.e. the namespace's current usage already exceeds the hard limit before any new pod is admitted.

The 20 running otel-demo pods request memory that sums to exactly 1901Mi (e.g. kafka 300Mi, flagd 120Mi plus flagd-ui 250Mi, fraud-detection 200Mi, accounting 160Mi), so ad's additional 225Mi request cannot fit under the 1503238553600m (~1433.6Mi) hard limit.
The current pod list for otel-demo contains 20 pods, all Running and Ready with 0 restarts and startTime 2026-11-16T18:04:2xZ; no ad-* pod (e.g. ad-554b849958-*) is present.
Service ad exists (selector opentelemetry.io/name=ad, port 8080) and the endpoint list for otel-demo contains 18 services with addresses but no ad entry, so Service ad has no ready backend.

Error rate by service for 18:30-18:51Z shows only frontend (0 -> peak ~4.41/s), frontend-proxy (0.0037 -> peak ~2.18/s) and negligible traces for ad (0.0037 -> 0), fraud-detection (0.0037/s), recommendation (0.0037/s) and 0 for accounting, payment; frontend-proxy's errors are on span_name ingress and router frontend egress.

Primary cause chain: pod ad-554b849958-p226w was stopped at 18:34:48Z (Deployment ad scaled 1->0 then back to 1 with the same ReplicaSet and revision 1), the replacement pod is rejected by ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory, so Service ad has no endpoints; frontend's grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds client spans then fail, which surface as errors on GET /api/data and thereby drive the frontend RequestErrorRate alert.

frontend-proxy is a downstream surface rather than an independent fault: its only error spans are ingress and router frontend egress (the route that proxies frontend), they start in the same minute and follow the same magnitude/shape as frontend's GET /api/data failures.

Rejected: an ad application crash, OOMKill or eviction. The only ad pod was cleanly stopped by its controller ('Stopping container ad' + ReplicaSet SuccessfulDelete), no Evicted/OOMKilled/FailedScheduling event exists, ad's own spans carried no error status on oteldemo.AdService/GetAds before it disappeared, and ad's span volume decaying to 0 is explained by the missing pods.

Rejected as the cause of the GetAds failures: the flagd feature-flag path. ad's only error spans were ~0.0037 spans/s on flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream for 18:32:50-18:36:50Z (about one span per 5 minutes), three orders of magnitude below the ~0.29-1.1 spans/s of failing grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds spans and with no evidence tying them to the GetAds path or to frontend's errors.

Every other otel-demo workload is healthy in the checked evidence: 20 of 21 deployments report readyReplicas equal to spec.replicas (only ad shows '<none>'), all 20 existing pods are Running/Ready with 0 restarts, and no otel-demo event other than the ad FailedCreate events was surfaced for the window.

Free memory-request headroom in namespace otel-demo (raise the otel-demo-memory quota hard limit above the 1901Mi already requested by the 20 running pods, or reduce requests such as flagd-ui 250Mi/kafka 300Mi/fraud-detection 200Mi) so that the ad ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 can create its 225Mi pod; then confirm a new ad-* pod reaches Ready, Service ad regains an endpoint, and frontend's grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds and GET /api/data errors stop.

Separately review what scaled Deployment ad from 1 to 0 and back to 1 at 18:34:48Z-18:34:58Z (deployment.kubernetes.io/revision stayed 1, so this was not a template rollout but a replica change) and whether the otel-demo-memory hard limit was reduced after the 18:04:2x pod creation, since the namespace must not be left in a state where no pod can be recreated.

gaps: change_history is not integrated, so it is unknown who or what scaled Deployment ad from 1 to 0 and back to 1 at 18:34:48Z/18:34:58Z, and whether the ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory hard value (1503238553600m) was changed during the window; all pods started 18:04:2xZ with 1901Mi total requests already above the current hard limit, which suggests a later change that could not be verified.

No application logs were readable for the failing path: fetch_pod_logs on frontend-675fd7b5c5-nkn95 returned 0 lines from the current container, and the previous instance did not exist, so the exact gRPC error text of grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds (for example connection refused vs no endpoints) was not observed.

Jaeger returned no traces for service frontend after 18:34:06Z (and none with error=true), so error span status messages/exception details for the incident window are unknown; error classification relies on traces_span_metrics status_code only, and span counts are not request counts.
The kube_deployment_status_replicas_available/ready series for deployment ad returned no data, so the timeline of ad ready replicas is unknown.
It is unknown whether Service ad endpoints had entries between 18:34:48Z and the query time; endpoint state was only observed now (no ad address).
The flagd error-state check for service flagd returned no data, so flagd's own error rate could not be confirmed one way or the other.
next_steps: Recommend a human operator raise or right-size the otel-demo-memory ResourceQuota so the ad pod (225Mi request) can be admitted, then verify a new ad pod becomes Ready and Service ad has an endpoint.
Recommend auditing the actor/automation that scaled Deployment ad to 0 at 18:34:48Z, using change-history tooling that was not available in this Run.
Recommend confirming after recovery that frontend's GET /api/data and grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds error rates return to 0 and that frontend-proxy ingress/router frontend egress error spans stop.
